title: rubus colemannii subsp. gremlii
intro: Rubus colemannii subsp. gremlii, commonly known as the Western American Black Raspberry, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Rubus colemannii subsp. gremlii include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and ellagic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
